_doc: The 32 iPhone cards of the Designer Library (assets/library-ads/), as iPhones LA picked them on 2026-11-03, with the words each feed still carries. Every claim below is one the library's own cards already make (same-day payment, any condition, any carrier, we meet you locally, no fees, free quote, firm quote by text, cash or transfer, the five towns, iPhone 15 to 18 Pro Max); nothing new is promised. A seller is asked for the IMEI or serial, never a picture (the owner, 2026-11-03: the shop's chatbot quotes from what is typed, 'pics is less ideal since we don't analyze photos as much'). 'line' replaces the card's small middle line (20 of the 32 carried 'iPhone 18 Pro Max • 18 Pro • 17 • 16 • 15', a model list that says nothing about how the service works) and is set at body size; 'cta' sits over the number. Each card also carries, after the owner's brief of 2026-11-03 ('we need all elements.. locations.. selling points.. hero.. sub title... cta.. watermark.. ideally device models we buy', 'something towards the top makes a bold claim'): 'claim' (the badge at the top: top dollar, max offer, always available, quick replies, honest buyer, top buyer; no '#1' or 'best', which would need proof), 'line' (now the models bought, or a steps card's steps), 'points' (three selling points, drawn by the engine as chips with their own check mark: an emoji inside a chip is split letter by letter, so the icons are the engine's accents and the pin in 'where'; mail-in is included because the shop sends prepaid labels) and 'where' (the towns over the website).
